## Failure mode

What should the check detect?

## Observable evidence

Which ROS graph, topic, TF, environment, or configuration signal indicates the failure?

## Normal cases / false positives

When could the same observation be expected?

## Minimal reproduction

Describe a small simulation or public example that reproduces the condition.
